surfaces.label: Claude Code (CLI, desktop Code tab, IDE extensions)

H1.rules: pre-commit lane when installed (plan decision #2) plus the budgeted Claude SessionEnd accelerator; CI backstop without lanes
H1.how: enforced-when-installed once the X1 replay fixture (T5) resolves and lanes are installed

H2.rules: the resolver library consumed by the Claude floor, the action policy and the H15 guard
H2.how: enforced-partial once TestProfileResolve and the claude-code probe resolve

H3.rules: in-tool: shell=False measures and the allowlist

H16.rules: generation checked by render_shims --check; installation only through H24 installers

H17.rules: identity scoping, transport block and Claude floor apply once the overlay is installed; bypass residuals: git -c hook.ws-claude-wall.enabled=false, --no-verify, env-scope config removal (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0), exec -a ancestor spoofing, an unsandboxed Claude process writing control/receipts.jsonl; H15 closes them at tool time
H17.how: enforced-partial once TestIdentity (T8) resolves; T8 owns this entry

H19.rules: N1 wrappers and the pinned host filter ship in wave 0; the hook core is registered only for probes
H19.how: enforced once the claude-code probe file exists

H22.rules: model-composed employer network git fails at the installed transport block; vetted housekeeping runs only through vetted_context (pinned blob check, policy via=vetted, receipts); local composed git and gh stay advisory until the floor and the gh belt
H22.how: TestActionPolicy runs the policy matrix and a composed-vs-vetted push --delete in temp repos; the live vetted run is Sean's G5c

H25.rules: report-only employer-substance scan when the lane is installed, plus a CI backstop
